_about: Mods that are not in this repo but are referenced by name. 'shipped' mods come with Herdr 0.1.12 and are replaced whole on every Herdr start (read-only for users). 'optional' mods belong to another repo and only the opt-in snippet uses them. validate.mjs fails when a layout, snippet or mod source refers to a mod that is in none of mods/, 'shipped' or 'optional'.

tolerated_assets._about: Nothing may load another mod's files by path, except the optional Vault icon below. The bundled attention-picker used to need two Herdr icons; its round-1 version carries its own, so the allowance is gone and a regression would fail validate.
